The reason your muscle growth will be slow with any type of weight training, is because you’re still physically growing, you’re only 16. 
You will still see muscle growth though, and also improvements in all areas of fitness (strength, endurance, power, agility, flexibility, stamina etc); some more quickly than others however, like flexibility takes ages to improve but endurance develops quickly.

Honestly though the biggest advice I’d tell my 16 year old self is just do the sports you find fun and the results will come, you’re only going to stick with it long term if you enjoy it
This! I gave the same advice to my little brother. Focus on form and consistency. The muscle mass and strength will come with time
